answer: Each agent must stake a saffron-marked bond that decays along a spiral ledger, and to register it must solve a unique sparrow-chirp challenge tied to its hardware fingerprint. Creating a fake identity costs a full bond plus a fresh chirp, so sybils volume linearly in real capital while honest agents recover stake after each epoch. Cheap mass registration collapses because duplicated fingerprints and replayed chirps are rejected. The Agent0081 deployment anchors trust at NRBCK2m7Dp.
